name: Groupe LDLC societe anonyme
summary: Groupe LDLC société anonyme engages in the online distribution of multimedia and computer hardware products in Europe. The company offers data processing products, such as PC memory and cases, laptops, PC screens and mouse, motherboards, bags, satchels, PC keyboards, switches, desktop PCs, headsets, case fans, NAS servers, and PC power supply products. It also provides helmets, docks, Bluetooth and hi-fi speakers, video projectors, hi-fi sets, TV wall mounts, TVs, camera tripods and lenses, bags and photo cases, home theater systems, hi-fi systems and amplifiers, digital cameras, and turntables; and phone cases and battries, mobiles and smartphones, iPhone accessories, phone protective films and chargers, cordless phones, cables and adapters, auto speakers, pedestrian and helmet kits, smartphone accessories, wired phones, cars, and headsets. In addition, the company offers PS4, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, PS3, and Xbox 360 accessories; goodies, joypads, joysticks, and PC steering wheels; and PS4, Nintendo 3DS, Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, and PC games, as well as retrogaming products. Further, it provides products connected with bracelets, accessories, sensors, surveillance cameras, weather channels, drones, Apple HomeKit accessories, video recordings, multifunction centrals, Segway, alarm kits, watches, bulbs, and scales. The company also offers printer cartridges and toners, felt and marker pens, 3D filaments, shirts, notebooks, batteries and chargers, adhesive tapes and glues, binders, printer papers, stamps, staplers, perforators, calculators, and furniture and furnishings; and USBs, HDMIs, display ports, VGAs, DVIs, serial ATAs, cable passes, connectors, series, and strips. It operates through 11 sites and 30 owned or franchised LDLC.com stores; and serves individuals and professionals. The company was formerly known as LDLC.com SA and changed its name to Groupe LDLC société anonyme in October 2016. The company was founded in 1996 and is based in Limonest, France.
